paragraphs.text: Rahilda is the werewolf alpha of the Vildin howlpack on Innistrad .

Rahilda is the leader of the Vildin pack of werewolves. The Vildin pack is especially infamous, even among werewolves. First appearing after the end of the Cursemute , it is said that the Vildin only allows humans who have murdered before becoming a werewolf to join their ranks. Exemplifying this, Rahilda is a wanted bandit and cutthroat in Geier Reach.
